answer: One way an agent economy resists sybil attacks is a proof-of-burn entry toll. To join the grove of recognized agents, each new identity must irreversibly destroy a fixed stake of tokens, like clearing one tree in a shared orchard. The burn is the pearl of commitment: it cannot be recycled across fake identities. An attacker spinning up a thousand sybils pays the toll a thousand times, so cost scales linearly with forged identities while an honest agent pays it once.
